meaning:
πεζός, -ή, -όν
(πούς), [in LXX for רַגְלִי ;]
1. on foot: Mat.14:13 (WH, mg., R, txt.).
2. Opp. to going by sea, by land: Mat.14:13 (WH, mg., R, mg.).
3. As adv., πεζῇ (sc. ὁδῷ), on foot or by land: Mt 1413 (WH, txt.), Mrk.6:33.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat, to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.
They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.
